continuity: The black-clad pursuers include undead who can keep moving after devastating Scorching Yang Qi injuries; they are advancing on Taekyung’s group.
Jeok Cheongang is fighting the Eastern Heaven Demon Lord and has realized he can strive beyond his current realm; he has unleashed a dramatically greater blaze.
plot: After Jin Taekyung’s Scorching Yang Qi attack, roughly half of the first hundred black-clad pursuers rise again despite catastrophic burns, showing no pain or signs of life. Taekyung recognizes them as undead and orders the group to run as an army of the dead advances.

During his fight with the Eastern Heaven Demon Lord, Jeok Cheongang recalls Hong Dao’s wager that he would surpass the Three Saints. Realizing his current realm is not his final limit, Jeok resolves to keep striving and strikes the Demon Lord with a blaze greater than any he has shown before.
translation_decisions: Render 언데드 as “undead”; retain “Eom Dae-du” in the exchange that mishears the term.
Render 무림서열록 as the italicized book title “Murim Ranking Record.”

active_continuity: Taekyung and the group are facing an advancing army of undead among the black-clad pursuers; roughly half of the first hundred struck by his attack rose again despite severe burns.
